metadata.note: Two cast elements pair cylinders 1+4 and 2+3 (33 mm outlets, FIA A-5295) into a twin downpipe; one pipe through the front, centre and rear silencers to two tailpipes. Lengths are estimates. Silencer, catalyst and collector-box bodies are straight pipes of their inlet diameter. Valve: two exhaust valves of 28 mm, 10.2 mm lift, 69 BBDC / 38 ATDC = 287 deg (FIA A-5295).
